newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ramsgate tops turnover on big trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ramsgate tops turnover on big trade.

text.p: The shares of emerging gold miner Ramsgate Resources NL topped the turnover list on the Australian Stock Exchange at midsession on Thursday with a parcel of 41 million shares totalling about 18 percent of the company's issued capital put through the market.
The stock was put through the market by Perth broker Porter Western at a price of 10 cents a share.
At 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Ramsgate shares were .006 cents higher at 10.5 cents with about 42 million shares traded.

Dealers said the buyer and seller of the large parcel were unknown but it was likely the company's joint venture partner in the Mt Monger gold project in Western Australia, General Gold Resources NL, had sold its 18.1 percent stake.
"It appears that General Gold has sold out," Perth-based dealer said. A spokesman for Ramsgate's major shareholder, Westgold Resources NL, said Westgold was not the buyer.
Ramsgate was subject to an offer from Westgold earlier this year which saw Westgold end up with 51.5 percent of the company.
Westgold offered a 1-for-1 share swap or a conditional bid of A$4.00 cash and 60 Westgold shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares, which valued Ramsgate at about A$24 million.
At 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Westgold shares were steady at 85 cents while General Gold shares were unchanged at 50 cents.
